decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The changelog entry [ev-3fd7b427b94e] says, under v3.0.0 bug fixes, that struct names in a code comment were corrected in the docker provider (#10503). That is concrete enough to write the assertion. The subject is a source-code comment in the docker provider. The change is an edit to comment text only, with no configuration, default or behaviour named. No customer environment is exposed, and the consequence is none, so the open aspects end up empty or not applicable rather than unknown. The PR is not needed to reach this.
